scripts.build: node init && npm run build:untouched && npm run build:optimized
scripts.build:untouched: node init && node ../../../bin/asc assembly/index.ts -t untouched.wat -b untouched.wasm --validate --sourceMap --measure
scripts.build:optimized: node init && node ../../../bin/asc assembly/index.ts -t optimized.wat -b optimized.wasm --validate --sourceMap --measure --noDebug --noAssert --optimize
